messages:
alex: starting config-only canary for routing-fallback + batching timeout tweak (change-id: cfg-2026-4821)

deploy-bot: Canary started on eng-dedicated-us-west-2 (10% traffic) — monitoring for latency & error spikes. See runbook: https://redwood.in/release/cfg-2026-4821

maria: noted. which params changed?

kai: small tweak: geo_fallback.priority -> prefer-local lowered to 0.6; batch_window_ms 60000 -> 30000; request_timeout_ms 6000 -> 5000

alex: it's config-only, no model pin. We'll pin routing-version:v3.2 for this canary to avoid accidental rollout to newer routing logic.

jess: ops note: enabling geo fallback might route more traffic cross-region if regional capacity drops. Keep an eye on p95 and cross-region egress.

opsbot: alert policy enabled: p95_latency > 220ms for 5m -> auto-rollback candidate. KV_cache_pressure > 80% -> notify paging.

maria: quick perf check: rolling out to 10% now. If no regressions by +10m, bump to 50% then full.

kai: backup plan: if KV cache pressure increases, rollback will revert batch_window_ms and geo_fallback.priority immediately using: `deploy-bot rollback cfg-2026-4821` (manual) or auto via opsbot.

alex: post-release notes: add a short note to the changelog and tag Dedicated customers who opted into low-latency. I'll update release notes after verification.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% stable for 12m. No errors >1% and p95 at 180ms. Ready for 50% ramp. Approve with `+1`.

jess: +1

maria: +1

kai: +1 — will watch KV cache metrics.

alex: bumping to 50% now. tagging @oncall in case of roll.

opsbot: ramp scheduled: 10% -> 50% at 1738102520. Auto rollback window 20m after ramp.

alex: documenting release note: "config: adjust geo fallback priority and reduce batch window to improve tail latencies; routing version pinned v3.2 for canary; auto-rollback policy in place." Link: https://redwood.in/changelog/2026-03-15

jess: FYI removing pin after full rollout? We should unpin after 4h if stable.

alex: agreed. I'll unpin at ~1738106320 unless we see regression.

deploy-bot: Full rollout complete at 1738102600. No rollback triggered. Closing thread.
